# Paris Heating & Cooling

> Serving Paris and the wider Brant/Haldimand-Norfolk region, Paris Heating & Cooling is a home comfort contractor covering furnace repair, air conditioner service, ductless installation, heat pumps, fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning for Ontario homeowners.

Phone: (548) 901-0930  |  Email: contact@parisheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://parisheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Paris, Brantford, Caledonia, Dunnville, Simcoe, Port Dover, Nanticoke, Ayr, Aylmer
